mapper.select: SELECT t2.product_part_sign, t2.model, t1.position_sign, t.position_stock_num, t3.pieces_sign pcsChn, t.position_code, t.primary_key FROM ${positionStockTableName} t LEFT JOIN ${positionTableName} t1 ON t.position_code = t1.primary_key LEFT JOIN ${productPartTableName} t2 ON t.material = t2.primary_key LEFT JOIN ${piecesTableName} t3 ON t2.pcs = t3.primary_key WHERE t.delete_flag = false AND t.enterprise_code = #{enterpriseCode} AND t1.primary_key = #{positionCode} order by t.create_time desc

SELECT t2.product_part_sign, t2.model, t1.position_sign, t.position_stock_num, t3.pieces_sign pcsChn, t.position_code, t.primary_key, t2.unity_no, t4.bar_code_number FROM ${positionStockTableName} t LEFT JOIN ${positionTableName} t1 ON t.position_code = t1.primary_key LEFT JOIN ${productPartTableName} t2 ON t.material = t2.primary_key LEFT JOIN ${piecesTableName} t3 ON t2.pcs = t3.primary_key LEFT JOIN ${stockTableName} t4 on t.stock = t4.primary_key WHERE t.delete_flag = false AND t.enterprise_code = #{enterpriseCode} AND t.stock = #{stockCode} order by t.create_time desc

select t2.warehorse || '-' ||t2.position_sign as positionChn, t.operation_type, t.operation_num, COALESCE(t3.pieces_sign,'-') pcsChn, t.operator, t.operation_time, t.check_batch_number, t.primary_key, t.check_version from ${positionOperationTableName} t left join ${productPartTableName} t1 on t.material = t1.primary_key left join ${positionTableName} t2 on t.position = t2.primary_key left join ${piecesTableName} t3 on t1.pcs = t3.primary_key where t.enterprise_code = #{enterpriseCode} and t.stock = #{requestData.stockCode} and t.delete_flag = false --- 过滤掉batch='系统导入' 且 operation_num = 0 且 detail_code is null 且 check_version is null -- and not (t.check_batch_number = '系统导入' and t.operation_num = 0 and t.detail_code is null and t.check_version is null and t.operation_type = false)
and t.check_batch_number like '%'|| #{requestData.batch} ||'%'
and t.operator = #{requestData.staffCode}
order by t.operation_time desc
